src="/images/11-Accomodation/Palm_view.jpg" alt="View of the Bilene lagoon"> <h1 style="text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px black;">Accommodation in Bilene</h1> <h2 style="color: #b0cff7; text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px black;">Peaceful, by the lagoon</h2> </section> <section id="introinfos"> <p>We have partnerships with the establishments offered, do not hesitate to contact us for availability and reservations.</p> </section> <section id="mainsection">  <div class="flexdiv background-bkc bkc-top"> <div class="flextext"> <h2>The BKC Houses</h2> <p>
Our own accommodations, right on the kite spot — drop your gear and you're already there.
                        The houses offer 2 bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, one of which has a sea view.
                        Terrace facing the lagoon, fully equipped shared kitchen (fridge, hob, utensils),
                        barbecue, parking and air conditioning. Towels provided, daily housekeeping.
                        Capacity 4 to 6 people.
</p> <table class="house-rates"> <thead> <tr> <th>Option</th> <th>Price / night</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td>Sea view room (2 pers.)</td> <td>70 €</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Standard room (2 pers.)</td> <td>50 €</td> </tr> <tr> <td>Whole house (4-6 pers.)</td> <td>100 €</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <a href="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MNscwvxhEcXRHAC0gnx9nUpDur7g3UC4?usp=drive_link" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="btn">📷 View all photos</a> </div> <div class="fleximg"> <img src="/images/11-Accomodation/houses/1.jpg" alt="BKC House exterior facing the sea"> <img src="/images/11-Accomodation/houses/2.jpg" alt="BKC House terrace overlooking the lagoon"> </div> </div> <div class="house-gallery-section background-bkc"> <div class="gallery"> <div class="gallery-item"> <div class="content"><img src="/images/11-Accomodation/houses/Exterieur.jpg" alt="BKC House exterior view" loading="lazy"></div> </div> <div class="gallery-item"> <div class="content"><img src="/images/11-Accomodation/houses/chambrevuemer.jpg" alt="Sea view bedroom" loading="lazy"></div> </div> <div class="gallery-item"> <div class="content"><img src="/images/11-Accomodation/houses/autre-chambre.jpg" alt="Second bedroom" loading="lazy"></div> </div> <div class="gallery-item"> <div class="content"><img src="/images/11-Accomodation/houses/sdb.jpg" alt="Private en-suite bathroom" loading="lazy"></div> </div> <div class="gallery-item"> <div class="content"><img src="/images/11-Accomodation/houses/cuisine.jpg" alt="Fully equipped shared kitchen" loading="lazy"></div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="flexdiv"> <div class="flextext"> <h2>The Palmeiras</h2> <p>This is where our kite center is located, a traditional all-comfort small resort, with its beach bar and restaurant on the beach, where you can enjoy a "2M" (the local beer) while watching
                        riders on the water. In addition to the houses above, they offer bungalows close to the sea, in different categories, right on or near the beach. As an indication, prices are around 50€ / night / standard bungalow and 120€ / night / deluxe bungalow by the water.
</p> </div> <div class="fleximg"> <img src="/images/11-Accomodation/Palm_house.jpg" alt="House interior in nature"> <img src="/images/11-Accomodation/Palm_Bung.jpg" alt="Bungalow in the forest"> </div> </div> <div class="flexdiv background"> <div class="flextext"> <h2>The San Martinho</h2> <p>Located 500m from our kite center, on the same beach, the San Martinho is the highest standing alternative on the lagoon. It offers hotel rooms
                        or comfortable houses to share, up to 4 bedrooms. It is carefully maintained, has several pools, a quality restaurant and beach bar.
                        As an indication, prices are around 120€ / night / room.
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.smbc.co.za/">San Martinho website</a> </p> </div> <div class="fleximg"> <img src="/images/11-Accomodation/SanMart1.webp" alt="Aerial view of a lagoon-side hotel"> <img src="/images/11-Accomodation/SanMart2.webp" alt="Aerial view of a lagoon-side hotel"> </div> </div> <div class="flexdiv"> <div class="flextext"> <h2>The Sunset</h2> <p>It's a bit of a compromise between our previous choices, located 800m from the kite center, on the same beach, the Sunset is a small peaceful hotel with
                        its quality restaurant (we often go there for dinner), well-kept rooms, an intermediate standing between the Palmeiras and the San Martinho.
                        As an indication, prices are around 80€ / night / room.
</p> </div> <div class="fleximg"> <img src="/images/11-Accomodation/Sun1.webp" alt="Restaurant terrace by a paradise lagoon"> <img src="/images/11-Accomodation/Sun2.webp" alt="Hotel room interior"> </div> </div> </section> </main> <footer> <a href="mailto:contact@bilenekite.com">Mail : contact@bilenekite.com</a> <div id="footicons"> <a href="https://www.facebook.com/288244685233804" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Facebook (nouvel onglet)"><img src="/images/icons/facebook-square-brands.svg" alt="Logo Facebook" loading="lazy"></a> <a href="https://www.instagram.com/bilene_kite_center_bkc/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Instagram (nouvel onglet)"><img src="/images/icons/instagram-brands.svg" alt="Logo Instagram" loading="lazy"></a> </div> <a href="https://airtricksprod.fr/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Air Tricks prod <span id="activeyear">2022</span></a> </footer> <script src="/js/burger.js"></script> <script src="/js/reveal.js"></script> <script src="/js/enquiry-form.js"></script> <script src="/js/gallery.js"></script> </body> </html>
